role: The server-side attribute map: registers ModifiableAttributeInstances, indexes them also by RangedAttribute description, and collects the watchable instances the client is told about.

members.name: descriptionToAttributeInstanceMap
members.note: the by-name NBT readers hardcode the known Name strings instead; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: getAttributeInstanceByName
members.note: exists only in the NBT load path: cp_restore_living matches the tag's Name strings against the ATTR_NAME table, entity_nbt.c player_attributes the same for the player

members.name: registerAttribute
members.note: the fixed six attributes are registered once at init, including their defaults; the already-registered IllegalArgumentException is unrepresentable

members.name: addAttributeInstance
members.note: the getShouldWatch gate and set insertion; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: getWatchedAttributes
members.note: no S20 update-attributes packet exists natively; the client hardcodes the sprint speed boost in player.c instead; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

notes: DEVLOG records the S20 sprint-attribute quirk as a client-side special case (player.c cp_set_sprinting/sp_set_sprinting multiply the base by 1.30000001192092896), which is where the watched movementSpeed attribute would otherwise flow. I did not verify any other watched attribute in this game. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers. Formerly listed as missing: the watchable-instance machinery (addAttributeInstance, getAttributeInstanceSet, getWatchedAttributes) has no native counterpart: attributes are never synced to the client. the description-keyed lookup (descriptionToAttributeInstanceMap) does not exist; potion.c and the NBT readers target the enum entries or hardcode the Name strings.
